descriptions.w3d_d20e_register_weapon_properties_8025: Registers the weapon property bindings (descriptors 0x803c8d9c..0x803c908c: IsAimedWeapon ... ImpulseRadius) through 0x801eb674/0x801ebf38/0x801ec52c, resets the DischargeFX, DischargeSoundFX, WormCollisionFX and LandCollisionFX strings (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string 0x804b06a0 through a temporary copy, sets the LogicalPositionOffset and ImpulseDirection vectors (0x801f0210) to the constant 0x803c90b4 (0.0f), calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
